summary.zh: 用任务队列把耗时操作移到后台执行
summary.en: Move long-running work into background workers

description.zh: 设计任务队列、工作进程和事件驱动流程，包含幂等处理、重试与任务状态流转。适合把发邮件、导出报表、处理上传等耗时操作从请求流程中剥离。
description.en: Designs task queues, workers, and event-driven flows with idempotency, retries, and job state handling. Use it to move slow work like email, exports, or media processing out of request cycles.
